notes: power residue x^2 mod 97 < 283/3: no plane program (only cubes and residues of a power-of-two period have a cube form)
power residue x^2 mod 97 <= 283/3: no plane program (only cubes and residues of a power-of-two period have a cube form)
power residue x^2 mod 97 >= 283/3: no plane program (only cubes and residues of a power-of-two period have a cube form)
power residue x^2 mod 97 > 283/3: no plane program (only cubes and residues of a power-of-two period have a cube form)
affine residue (37 x + 3) mod 1000 < 2305/3: no plane program (only cubes and residues of a power-of-two period have a cube form)
affine residue (37 x + 3) mod 1000 <= 2305/3: no plane program (only cubes and residues of a power-of-two period have a cube form)
affine residue (37 x + 3) mod 1000 >= 2305/3: no plane program (only cubes and residues of a power-of-two period have a cube form)
affine residue (37 x + 3) mod 1000 > 2305/3: no plane program (only cubes and residues of a power-of-two period have a cube form)
case 1: 279 predicates (maps x thresholds x operators), 0 with a mismatch on a row or a code of the domain

case 2, cases the transformed plane predicate loses (retained): 16 branches, selectivity 0.01: numpy lookup 1.57e-03s vs plane 6.07e-03s (31 instructions); 16 branches, selectivity 0.5: numpy lookup 1.65e-03s vs plane 5.79e-03s (31 instructions); 17 branches, selectivity 0.99: numpy lookup 1.67e-03s vs plane 3.04e-03s (33 instructions); 64 branches, selectivity 0.01: numpy lookup 1.76e-03s vs plane 2.14e-02s (127 instructions); 64 branches, selectivity 0.5: numpy lookup 1.83e-03s vs plane 1.35e-02s (127 instructions); 65 branches, selectivity 0.99: numpy lookup 1.85e-03s vs plane 2.27e-02s (129 instructions)

CPU = native libalg; CUDA timings only with --device (emulated runs are compared with the CPU in tests/test_math_preimg.py, never timed as CUDA); NumPy and DuckDB evaluate the original predicate exactly (integers multiplied through by positive denominators); the engine plane predicate is at_filter_bitmap_masked on the set's program (an OR of BETWEENs of the intervals, or of ANDs of bit literals for cubes and residues mod 2^k).
